entry.title: New: Bill 226 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 24-32, AS AMENDED, THE OPERATING BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2025

Increases revenues in the Federal Grants – National Instant Criminal Background Check Act Record Improvement Program account ($15,579)

Latest action: Council: Bill 226 passes second & final reading - 01/08/25
